data.action: 向日葵花摊前回眸一笑
data.camera: medium shot, eye level at a sunflower stall
data.description: 【塞西莉亚 · 小镇市集·向日葵花摊与明媚回眸】阳光明媚的小镇夏日市集上，塞西莉亚站在盛开的金黄色向日葵花摊前，双手按着被微风吹拂的白色软帽，回过头对你露出毫无防备的明媚笑容——「劳伦斯你看！这朵向日葵开得多漂亮！今天能和你一起出来散步，真的太幸福了！」
data.promptProse: Cecilia stands before a sunflower stall in the summer town market, keeping both hands on her wide-brimmed straw hat against the breeze and turning toward Lawrence with a bright smile. Her floral sundress remains clear in the eye-level medium view. Yellow blooms overlap the stall awning behind her. Sunny daylight shines through petal edges and hat weave, with a gentle brim shadow across her forehead.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 小镇市集·向日葵花摊与明媚回眸
